description: booksguard: every QuickBooks and Xero write by the agent waits for the person's yes, with a dry-run diff

hooks.command: d="${BOOKSGUARD_HOME:-$HOME/.booksguard}"; f="$(cat "$d/cli-path" 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then exec node "$f" hook pre-tool-use --client claude; fi; exec npx -y --allow-git=root github:agentwares/booksguard hook pre-tool-use --client claude
